result.note: Tested the commissioning of three indigenous warships: venue, indigenous content and the BrahMos-armed stealth frigate.

questions.prompt: In June 2026, Prime Minister Narendra Modi commissioned three indigenously built warships. Consider the following statements about them:
items: The warships were commissioned in Kolkata.
One of them is a stealth frigate armed with BrahMos missiles.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because the warships' indigenous content was above 75%, not below 60%. All three ships were indigenously built and commissioned together in Kolkata on 22 June 2026.
questions.source: Modi commissioned three indigenously built warships in Kolkata, with indigenous content above 75%, including a BrahMos-armed stealth frigate.
